name: App Icon: Crimson Flame Katana
purpose: Primary App Store Icon — Flaming Blade Emblem.
description: Vertical pitch-black katana silhouette cleaving upward, wreathed in sharp clean crimson solar flames inside a circular gold and crimson seal.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D vector game app icon. A vertical Japanese samurai katana sword silhouette pointing upward in center, near-black hilt with a razor-sharp glowing crimson-red cutting edge radiating clean geometric crimson flame arcs. (Directly centered inside a perfectly smooth circular crimson-red solar seal with gold rim:1.4). Pitch-black background, pristine vector geometry, razor-sharp clean edges, flat 2D graphic emblem, no 3D, no text, no watermark, no pixelation, no noise.
